text:
alex: quick flag — the release-notes page links to the micro-release schedule anchor `/guides/release-notes#micro-schedule` but the heading is 'Micro release schedule (oncall)' so the fragment should be `#micro-release-schedule-oncall`. it's causing a 404 from the deploy checklist flow. planning a tiny PR to fix link + add a 1-line oncall handoff note. who owns release-notes?
morgan: that doc is on my plate this quarter. tiny PRs ok. paste the exact line that links to it?
alex: the markdown is `See the micro release timings: [micro schedule](../guides/release-notes#micro-schedule)`
priya: heads-up — if you add an oncall handoff sentence, please reference `/playbooks/oncall#handoffs` and include UTC ranges. otherwise LGTM. also request we add a linkcheck test so CI catches this in future.
doc-bot: created task docs:linkfix-271 "release-notes micro-schedule anchor + oncall handoff blurb" assigned to @morgan, reported by @alex
alex: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1720 — fixes fragment, adds line: "Oncall handoffs for micro releases: follow playbook (UTC windows) and notify #eng-oncall.", and a small linkcheck in docs/tests. tagging @morgan @priya for review.
morgan: skimmed the diff — anchor fix and linkcheck look good. left one nit about wording: prefer "notify the oncall channel" instead of mentioning the channel by name (internal style).
priya: agree with the wording nit. also can we run a quick grep for `#micro-schedule` across i18n and playbooks before we merge? might be duplicates.
alex: will run grep and post results here in a minute.
alex: grep done: found two hits in `i18n/ja/guides/release-notes.md` and `playbooks/release-process.md` (relative link). i'll open tiny follow-ups for the playbook and ping localization for the ja file.
morgan: thanks — if the playbook change is small, add it to the same PR as a follow-up commit so reviewers see related context. keeps the rollup tidy.
doc-bot: linked issue docs:extlink-73 to PR #1720 for follow-up i18n and playbook updates.
priya: sounds good. once wording nit is fixed and CI passes, i'll approve and merge. thanks for catching this, @alex :rocket:
